Yes — if a page I saved later disappears, I'd absolutely want the app to hold on to everything I have: my title, description, tags, my notes, the icon, the preview, and the address, all just as they were. None of that should be deleted or quietly replaced. Even if clicking the title then leads to a page that's gone, my own record of why I saved it is still valuable to me, and losing it because the website vanished would be the worst outcome.

While we're on it — this is the situation where I'd most wish the app had quietly kept a readable copy of the page itself from back when it worked, so a dead link isn't a total loss. That's not something you need to solve this moment, but it's very much in the spirit of "don't let me lose what I saved." For the behavior you're actually asking about, though, yes: keep everything unchanged.
